title: Measure the cost of a landed change: a baseline over real landings
outcome: Each landed change has a read-only record of its cost, so a later target (for example 30% less, with no weaker tests or review) can be judged against a measured baseline rather than an impression.
acceptance: A read-only report gives, per landed change, what can be measured from existing records: elapsed time, messages, test runs including duplicates, false refusals, Greg's interventions and queue age, and tokens if any source records them; what can't be measured is named, not estimated.
A baseline over real landings is recorded after the simple evaluation rule's end-to-end run has passed on Windows and Linux. No new procedure, gate or required step is added to landing.
